business_overview.one_sentence: PICC Group is an integrated insurance financial group operating P&C insurance, life insurance, health insurance, reinsurance, pension, asset management and related investment holding businesses.
segments: Reinsurance and other insurance financial services
business_overview.revenue_model: Insurance service revenue, interest income, investment income, fair-value changes and other insurance financial operating income.
business_notes: Insurance funds investment is a normal operating business, not a detachable excess-cash pool.
Financial investments support insurance liabilities, solvency and investment yield.
